guidance: Choose the visual kind that matches the governed query shape. Do not invent fields or data.
dashboard_guidance: Compose a dashboard from governed query plans. Each tile chooses a kind and plan matching that kind's metric, grouping, time and additive rules. Start with KPIs, then trends, comparisons, composition and detail. Prefer the simplest kind that answers the question and never provide data values.

kpi.use: A single headline number, such as a total count or sum.

bar.use: Rank or compare categories, especially many or long labels.

column.use: Compare a few categories with short labels.

donut.use: Part-to-whole share across at most six categories.

funnel.use: Drop-off across ordered stages or outcomes.

line.use: Trend over time for up to three measures, or one measure split by one category.

area.use: Volume of one additive measure over time.

stacked_bar.use: Composition of one additive measure across two groupings, or across a category over time.

grouped_bar.use: Side-by-side comparison of two or three measures per category, or one measure across two groupings.

heatmap.use: Intensity of one measure across two groupings, such as processor by error.

scatter.use: Relationship between two measures across categories.

sankey.use: Flow of an additive measure from one grouping to another.

table.use: Exact values or detail that a chart would hide.
